motivation: Stage 9 passed its frozen held-out-seed Development confirmation rule. Authorize one separately preregistered FinalTest re-evaluation of the already fixed endpoint cohort, without any further training or selection.

frozen_confirmation_boundary.policy: No model tensor, selected configuration, request population or Development outcome may change after this boundary.

historical_test_exposure.description: This is a new post-Development-tuning re-evaluation on the previously used ML-1M FinalTest cohort, not the original untouched one-shot evaluation and not an independently collected new holdout.
historical_test_exposure.current_selection_policy: Stage 7/8 settings and Stage 9 confirmation used only Development. No new Stage 10 test prediction is available when this amendment is frozen.
historical_test_exposure.interpretation_limit: The prior exposure must be disclosed. A new access ledger does not restore statistical independence or erase historical test exposure.

stage10_finaltest.lineage: The last 20,000 eligible examples in the authoritative timestamp/user/movie-ordered ML-1M chronological reconstruction, validated exactly against test_10_simple.json after access reservation.
stage10_finaltest.endpoint_authority: Use exactly the Stage 9 audit endpoint inventory. Seed 42 uses the evaluated Stage 8 response-scale-one adapter; seeds 41/43 use their frozen formal scale-one endpoints. The registered numerical reproduction gate is not an exact tensor-equality claim.
stage10_finaltest.sisa_policy: Report the frozen NO_ELIGIBLE_CANDIDATE decision. Do not promote a failed SISA setting, exclude adverse evaluated rows, or select a replacement using FinalTest.
stage10_finaltest.primary_quantity: E_U: requested-user mean absolute Yes-probability error to the matched 200-step Exact-Masked endpoint.
required_metrics: local residual E_U/D_U and user-cluster bootstrap 95% confidence interval
overall AUC, accuracy and binary log loss
Yes/No JSD and probability L2 RMS to Exact-Masked
Retain-Retrain-P5 residual using FullControl-P5 as its control and user-cluster bootstrap 95% confidence interval
requested-user example support and missing-user support
fixed inference wall time, endpoint hashes and access ledger
stage10_finaltest.retain_retrain_role: Separately labeled converged-endpoint sensitivity, reported alongside the matched-local comparison for every evaluated method; it is not hidden in an appendix or used to select endpoints.
stage10_finaltest.aggregation: Report all 60 seed/scenario/method cells. For each scenario and method, report mean and sample standard deviation across three model seeds. Also report an unweighted six-cell mean E_U for each method. User-cluster bootstrap intervals are conditional on each model seed and are not a substitute for seed variation.
stage10_finaltest.descriptive_confirmation_rule: BOTA passes both utility guardrails without collapse and has local residual below 1 in all six cells, and its unweighted six-cell mean E_U is lower than each of the five fixed eligible baselines. Report each component even if the conjunction fails; no retry, retuning or selective reporting follows.
stage10_finaltest.empty_support_policy: If an entire fixed request has zero FinalTest support, fail the evaluation and retain the access-failure record. Missing individual-user support is reported; requests are never replaced.

access_policy.failure_policy: Keep a permanent access-failure record and prediction-call count. Do not automatically retry even under a different run name. Any infrastructure recovery requires a separate evidence-based amendment.
access_policy.publication: Atomically publish a complete evaluation only after all 60 cells, the full requested-user prediction inventory, metrics and hashes are written.

interpretation_rules: Do not change Stage 3--6 negative conclusions or broaden the 200-step local validity scope based on this re-evaluation.
All adverse results and all five eligible baseline comparisons must be retained.
This is behavioral matched-counterfactual approximation evaluation, not an attack-based privacy certificate or proof of arbitrary continuous deletion.
Report historical FinalTest exposure and distinguish this result from the original paper evaluation.
No paper claim or repository headline is automatically changed until the full Stage 10 audit is complete.
